name: Spend Bill Gates' Money
summary: Spend Bill Gates' Money is a satirical web-based simulation game by Neal.fun that gives players a hypothetical $100 billion budget to spend as they see fit. The game features an interactive shopping grid where you can purchase everything from minor everyday items like a Big Mac or a Netflix subscription, to luxury assets including supercars, mega yachts, famous works of art, and entire sports franchises. It offers a humorous and eye-opening visual exploration of extreme wealth and the scale of modern billionaires' fortunes.
